text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As the celebrations get underway on the Marjan Coast,
{0} is wandering lazily along the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海開きで賑わっているマルジェン海岸で、
{0}はのんびりと砂浜を歩いていた。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hey! {0}!
Talk about purr-fect timing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい！
　{0}ーっ！
　
にゃんていい所にーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hey—why are you running?! Hold on a minute!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、なぜ逃げるにゃ！
　
ちょっと待つにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hahh! I caught ya!
If I let go, you'll probably run off again, so let's talk like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅっ、
捕まえたにゃ！
　
手を離すと逃げちゃいそうだからこのまま話すにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: We're going hunting for a cat-shaped shell!
choice_data_list: Shells aren't shaped like cats, silly.
text_block_list.orig_text: 猫型の貝殻を探しに行くにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: This one is! I've seen it with my own eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あるにゃ！
　実際見たにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: The stand can wait—I need that shell!
text_block_list.orig_text: 今はお店より猫型の貝殻にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
One of the customers who bought my taiyaki
had a seashell accessory that looked just like a cat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきたい焼きを買ってくれたお客さんが、
猫の形をした貝殻のアクセサリーを付けてたにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, that shell's said to bring happiness!
The perfect shape, and lucky too?!
Isn't that just the cat's pajamas?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとその貝は
幸せを呼ぶにゃ！
猫の形をしてる上に
幸せまで呼ぶなんて最高にゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh no, I'm not letting you get away.
I've got you firmly in my paws!
You're coming with me to find that shell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お～っと、
逃げようとしても無駄にゃ。
この手は離さないにゃ！
猫型の貝殻を一緒に探すにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
It's my policy to surround myself with all my favorite things!
And I can't miss out on a shell like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしは
好きなものに囲まれて生活するのがポリシーにゃ。
猫型の貝殻もその一つにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyow, let's get down to the beach and hunt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
さっそく海岸に探しに行くにゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Come out, come out, kitty cat shell!
I'm gonna give you a loving home! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
猫型貝殻出てくるにゃ～
あたしがかわいがってあげるにゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you've gotta search too, {0}!
My nine lives' happiness is on the line here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}も頑張って探してほしいにゃ～
あたしの幸せな人生がかかってるにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Pretty little kitty shell...
Shall I make a pendant of you? Or a nyice brooch?
text_block_list.orig_text:
猫型の貝殻……
ペンダントにしようかにゃ、
ブローチにしようかにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
With that lucky shell, my taiyaki stand
will be flooded with hungry customers,
and I'll be a rich kitty in nyo time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
貝殻を手にしたあたしの店には、
きっと連日お客が押し寄せ、
あれよあれよという間にお金持ちに……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and don't worry, I'll reward you too!
How about a special discount on my world-famous taiyaki?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
{0}にもちゃんとお礼するにゃ。
あたしのたい焼きを
特別割引でご奉仕するにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's the taiyaki lady! What're you doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
たい焼きのお姉ちゃんだ！
　
何やってるの？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oho, if it isn't one of my best little customers!
We're on the hunt for a cat-shaped seashell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
いつもたい焼きを買ってくれる女の子にゃ！
あたし達は今
猫型の貝殻を探してるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A kitty seashell?!
That sounds like fun! I wanna help too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　猫型の貝殻！？
　
面白そうだから
あたしも手伝う～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?! What a nyice little girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントにゃ！？
　嬉しいにゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Searching's always easier with friends to help!
text_block_list.orig_text: 探し物は人がたくさんいる方が捗るにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: OK then! I'll go look over that way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃああたし、
あっちの方見てみるねー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Good luck!
text_block_list.orig_text: お願いにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm, there's nyo sign of the shell anywhere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
なかなか見つからないにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I don't think I've ever seen a kitty seashell before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
猫型の貝殻なんて
見たことないもんねー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
All we've uncovered so far are little pink shells and spiky sea snails,
squidgy sea urchins, and a pearl oyster...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきから見つかるのは、
桜貝やサザエのようなもの、
ウニらしき物体、
真珠貝……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Some of them are pretty or valuable,
but nyot one of them's what I'm looking for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
綺麗だったり高価だったりするけど、
あたしが欲しいのは猫型の貝殻にゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Doesn't that shell over there on those rocks
look sort of like a kitty cat?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　そこの岩の上に落ちてるのって、
猫型の貝じゃない？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Where?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ！？
　どこにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I'll go and get it for you!
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしが取ってきてあげるねー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Watch where you step, nyow!
text_block_list.orig_text: 足元に気を付けるにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh! These rocks are a bit wobbly, but I'm OK!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ、
ちょっとぐらぐらするけど
大丈夫！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Got it! It really does look like a kitty, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あった！
　
やっぱり猫型の貝だよお姉ちゃん！

text_block_list.text: CRAAAAAB...
text_block_list.orig_text: カニカニー

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what was that nois—
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ！？
　
今、
何か聞こえ……！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaghhhh! What is this thing?! I thought it was just a rock!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあああああっ！
　なにこれっ！
　さっきまで岩だったのに！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: That's no rock... It must be a cleverly camouflaged Spike Crab!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれは、
岩じゃなくて擬態していたスパイククラブだったにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Spike Crab
text_block_list.text: CRAAAAAB...
text_block_list.orig_text: カニカニー

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Aahhh...! There are so many of them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ……
どんどん増えてきてるぅっ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Where did the shell go?!
Oh no, oh no, did I drop it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
拾った貝殻がないっ……！
　
どうしよう、
どこに……！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Forget the shell! Leave this to me and get out of there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないにゃっ！
　あたしに任せて逃げるにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Spike Crab
text_block_list.text: *blurble blurble*
text_block_list.orig_text: ブクブクブクー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myaaaahhh?! What nyow?! They sprayed something at me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃああっ！？
　なに！？
　
なんか吹き付けられたにゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: A-are these bubbles?! Myamyaahh! Get them oooooff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これは泡っ！？
　ふにゃあああっ！
　いやにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I'm all wet! I can't stand water! It's all wet and slippery!
text_block_list.orig_text:
濡れてるにゃ！
　水は嫌いだにゃーっ！
　まとわりつくにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Spike Crab
text_block_list.text: CRAAAAAB!
text_block_list.orig_text: カニカニー

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way! She's gone into a frenzy,
and she's sending monsters flying everywhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいっ！
　暴れるお姉ちゃんに
どんどん魔物が巻き込まれてくっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Get off meeee! Stay baaack! Don't get me weeeeet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来るにゃーっ！
　寄るにゃーっ！
　あたしを濡らすにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
S-somehow all the monsters are out for the count...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……はぁ……
い、
いつの間にか
魔物が倒れてるにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Taiyaki lady! Are you OK?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん！
　大丈夫！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'm all right...
And look, the shell you found is safe too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だにゃ。
あと、
貝殻もほら
無事だったにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wow, awesome! You found the shell after I dropped it!
I guess you got your prize, taiyaki lady!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ、
すごいっ！
　落とした貝殻、
拾ってくれてたんだね！
見つかって良かったね、
お姉ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Yes... But I think this belongs to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
でも、
この貝はキミにあげるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh? But... you really wanted this shell, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？
　
でも……
お姉ちゃんが欲しがってた貝なのに……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. You're the one who spotted it first.
Hold onto this shell and you'll be blessed with happiness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にしなくていいにゃ。
最初に手にしたのはキミなんだから。
これを持っていると、
幸せになれるんだにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you... It's a really cute shell, too!
I'm gonna go show it to my mommy!
Bye-bye, nice taiyaki lady!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがとう……
とってもかわいい貝殻だねっ。
あたし、
お母さんに見せてくる！
　じゃあねお姉ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye! Drop by my stand again sometime!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't regret that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
またお店に遊びに来てにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut up! I can always find anyother shell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるさいにゃ！
　貝殻はまた探せばいいにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm nyot crying at all!
I just... got some of those bubbles in my eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
泣いてなんかないにゃ！
　これは、
泡が目に入っただけにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: That girl just had a nyasty scare, so she's earned it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子には怖い思いをさせちゃったし、
これでいいのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when she eats my taiyaki with a smile,
that makes me happiest of all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
あの子がまたたい焼きを買いに来てくれた方が、
あたしは嬉しいのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Though she'd given away the precious shell she was looking for,
Tamaki looked surprisingly satisfied in the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
欲しかった貝殻はあげてしまったが、
タマキは満足そうに笑うのであった。
